messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: gpu_capacity_alert eu-west1 (gcp-europe-west1) — queue length > 400, token-generation errors increasing. Severity: P1. Pager: @alex.sre. Link: https://monitoring.redwood.corp/alerts/9876

alex.sre: ack. jumping in. pulling dashboards now.

katie-ops: seeing sustained queue growth on `text-gen-prod-eu` pools. autoscaler tried to scale but nodes stayed at 0 -> `ScaleUpError: quotaExceeded` in controller logs.

devin-infra: confirm. from autoscaler logs: `failed to create instance: projects/redwood/zones/europe-west1-b/instances: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 1234567 in region europe-west1`. full trace: ```2026-03-15T20:03:22Z controller.go:234 ScaleUp: request 8 gpus -> error: quotaExceeded (403) ticket_pending_id=null```

morgan-devex: any recent config changes? routing or model changes could spike demand.

alex.sre: no config deploys in eu this hour. looks like workload spike from a customer load test + background warmers. Customer-eng bot shows a ramp from account `acme-llm` starting 20:01 UTC. @customer-eng-bot can you confirm?

customer-eng-bot: confirmed. acme-llm ramped to ~300 concurrent requests across streaming endpoints at 20:01 UTC. They used our hosted API; we didn't throttle them because they were within quota.

katie-ops: impact: 12% 500s on eu users for text-generation, tail latency > 15s for some calls. Some requests falling back to error path. customer-facing incidents page: https://status.redwood.corp/incident/1736001111

devin-infra: mitigation options — short list:
- request emergency GPU quota bump from GCP (slow, best-effort)
- reroute eu traffic to us-west2 region by updating smart routing policy (fast, but increases latency for EU customers)
- enable soft-fallback to lower-capacity model variant (quantized int8) for non-critical requests
- reduce warmers / pause non-essential batch jobs

alex.sre: immediate: pause warmers and batch jobs. can we flip routing for 20% of traffic to us-west2 as canary?

morgan-devex: I can push a routing tweak to divert 20% via `routing:region_bias` in the control plane. Example snippet: ```PATCH /v1/policies/route-weights { "region_bias": {"europe-west1": 0.8, "us-west2": 0.2} }``` Should be safe.

devin-infra: doing that now. filing support ticket with GCP with `quota_expedite=true`. ticket id: GCP-452198 (sent 20:07 UTC).

alex.sre: apply routing change, and pause warmers. katie, can you take warmers?

katie-ops: pausing non-prod warmers + lower-priority batch jobs. `kubectl scale --replicas=0 job/warmers-eu` done.

devin-infra: routing change applied. monitoring shows 18% traffic shifting within 2m. new autoscaler logs: attempted create instances in us-west2 -> success (created 4 GPUs). eu queue decreased 30% after reroute.

alex.sre: good. note: us-west2 instances are older GPU type, so latency for rerouted requests + ~40-80ms extra network. but better than failures.

morgan-devex: pushed temporary fallback policy to use `model-llama-3-small-int8` for non-streaming requests when eu latency > 10s. snippet: ```if latency_eu > 10s then route->model-llama-3-small-int8```

customer-eng-bot: acme-llm notified via automated channel (DM) that we observed an elevated error rate and we're rerouting some traffic. They replied: "Thanks, we're pausing our test."

devin-infra: GCP responded to support ticket: quota increase is UNDER REVIEW, no ETA. They asked for justification and requested account billing contact verification. I uploaded the details.

alex.sre: longer-term: we should provision warm standby capacity in a second region for EU heavy customers. For now, keep routing policy in place until quota confirmed.

katie-ops: current metrics (20:20 UTC): eu 5xx down to 1.5%, queue length from 420 -> 110. overall system tokens/sec normalized to 70% of peak.

morgan-devex: pushing note to status page with mitigation details and that some EU traffic is routed to US with possible latency increase. PR ready: https://git.internal/status/pr/8891

alex.sre: prepping handoff for night oncall. leaving these action items:
- devin: follow up with GCP support until quota bump approved (ticket GCP-452198)
- katie: keep an eye on queue length and rollback routing once healthy
- morgan: keep status updates / customer comms
- oncall-night: be ready to increase routing bias or enable additional fallback models if queue resurges

oncall-night: ack. I will join in 20m for handoff and will monitor dashboards. pls add any notes to the handoff doc: https://confluence.redwood.corp/incidents/1736001111-handbook

alex.sre: thanks team. leaving channel for now, handing to @oncall-night. :white_check_mark:

oncall-night: joining. quick note: created a temporary runbook checklist under the confluence page — includes commands to revert routing, to add regional allows, and to re-enable warmers.

devin-infra: update 21:10 UTC — GCP support replied asking for expected sustained GPU count and spike window. I pushed an estimate and asked for expedite.

katie-ops: update 21:25 UTC — traffic stable, rolling average queue < 80, errors ~0.8%. keeping routing at 0.8/0.2 for now. will dial back slowly starting in 30m.

oncall-night: noted. leaving a final short summary for the post-incident notes: "Cause: sudden customer load + insufficient regional GPU quota -> autoscaler hits GCP GPU quota and fails to create instances. Mitigation: pause non-essential jobs, route ~20% EU traffic to US region, enable quantized fallback models for non-critical requests, opened expedite ticket with GCP. Impact: brief elevated 5xx (~12% at peak) for EU customers; reduced to ~1% after mitigation. Next steps: apply regional warm standby and automate cross-region routing policy for quota failures."

morgan-devex: adding customer follow-up template and suggested wording to confluence.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated): auto-close after 6h if no regression.

oncall-night: closing thread here; moving followups into the postmortem doc. thanks all. :raised_hands:
